reason: A conversation input utility that uses the selected language model to deepen and optimize draft prompts, then places the editable result back in the input field.

summaries.zh: 在会话输入框中添加“深化”按钮，调用当前选定模型优化草稿提示词并将可编辑结果写回输入框。
summaries.en: Adds a conversation input button that uses the currently selected model to refine a draft prompt and write the editable result back into the input field.

capabilities: Adds a button to the conversation input toolbar
Sends the draft prompt to the currently selected language model for refinement
Writes the refined prompt back into the input field
Displays success or error status feedback
